text:
Maria: Heads-up — thinking about a slightly different format for this year's annual planning: a two-day "field day" (hybrid) on May 12-13 to focus on roadmap scenarios, launch-readiness, and negotiation of scope with customers. Need to lock facilitation owners, scenario walkthroughs, and the explicit launch criteria for top initiatives. Who can take facilitation for the "Serving economics & routing" deep-dive?

Ken: I can run the serving economics session (45m). Will prepare a short prep doc and a cost/latency tradeoff matrix. Need AV + a whiteboard for live sketching. :whiteboard:

Aisha: I'll own the session on customer-driven asks (60m). Requesting two PMs to bring ranked customer asks and one slide per ask. We should gate that session with a small rubric so we don't scope creep.

Raj: SRE can own capacity & incident readiness (30m). I'd like to include canary/rollback criteria and the perf-regression playbook. Also checklist for Dedicated vs Private deployments (what we allow to go to prod).

Zoe: Logistics: I'll reserve three breakout rooms and set up Zoom rooms + breakout links for remote folks. Can we confirm headcount by EOD Friday so I can order catering for the in-person track? :pretzel:

Elena: I'll coordinate facilitator rotation and run an inclusion + hybrid facilitation play in a 30m dry run. I'll create a calendar and a short facilitator guide. Please populate this sheet with your session materials: https://tiny.redwood/field-day-prep (fill by May 1).

Ken: Draft launch-readiness checklist (small excerpt):
```
- clear success metrics (e.g., p95 latency < 250ms, cost/unit targets)
- canary rollout + automated rollback thresholds
- smoke tests + perf/regression test suite green
- observability: dashboards + alerting + runbook links
- security/data handling sign-off for Private deployments
- post-launch ownership & SLOs
```

Maria: Love that checklist — we should make each high-priority initiative have a one-pager that maps initiative -> owner -> launch criteria (measurements + cutoff) + rollback plan. A single page we can show execs.

Aisha: Also propose adding a small quality-eval step: a prompt/eval harness snapshot for any model work (baseline + target). If quality regresses vs baseline, we don't ship. Put that in the one-pager.

Raj: Note on hardware: if any initiative depends on a Dedicated-only kernel or quantized build, call it out. Those runs take a week to validate on infra side.

Zoe: Tentative schedule (please comment):
```
Day 1
09:00-09:30 - Breakfast + quick OKR alignment (all)
09:30-10:15 - Roadmap framing + risk review (Maria)
10:30-11:15 - Serving economics deep-dive (Ken)
11:30-12:30 - Customer asks + prioritization (Aisha)
12:30-13:30 - Lunch
13:30-15:00 - Scenario walkthroughs (small groups)
15:15-16:00 - Capacity & canary planning (Raj)
16:15-17:00 - Synthesis + next steps (all)

Day 2
09:00-10:30 - Cross-functional launch-readiness clinics (rotate)
10:45-12:00 - Exec one-pagers & negotiation practice (mock execs)
13:00-15:00 - Rollout runbook lab + dry runs (SRE + Eng Leads)
15:15-16:00 - Wrap + commit board
```

Elena: I'll run a 30m dry run for facilitators on May 5 at 10am PT. Please confirm your session slides by May 3.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: May 12-13, 09:00-17:00 PT — "Annual field day: roadmap, launch-readiness, and negotiation". Attendees: product, eng, design, SRE, people-ops.

Maria: Thanks everyone — please react with :thumbsup: if your assigned slot works and drop blockers if not. If you haven't volunteered for facilitation but want to co-facilitate, say so here.

Ken: :thumbsup: — will post the prep doc and matrix by next Tue.

Aisha: :thumbsup: — will gather the two PM ask decks and post links.

Raj: +1. Need an infra validation window May 6-8 for Dedicated tests.

Zoe: Working on headcount ask — will post final numbers Friday.

Elena: Added facilitator rota and dry-run invite.

Maria: Perfect. If anyone has customer stakeholders we should invite for negotiation practice, DM me.

Aisha: Quick Q — do we want a strict rule for scope negotiation? I suggest: "no new cross-cutting infra work unless paired with a committed Dedicated budget". Thoughts?

Raj: Agree. We can allow small infra changes as tech debt tickets but anything that needs Dedicated commit moves to later sprint unless approved by infra council.

Maria: OK — we'll put that as a gating policy in the one-pager template. Thanks all.
